$comment: CANONICAL attribute-budget formula. Ruled in Decision 0007 under Director delegation, 2026-08-02, satisfying the ROADMAP Phase 0 gate item 'One canonical attribute-budget formula chosen'. Candidates and the measurement that drove the ruling are in docs/phase0/attribute_budget_candidates.md.
curve_definition: 1x on magnitude 0-40, 2x on 41-70, 3x on 71-100. Tier boundaries deliberately match Rule 10's own caps and compensation thresholds so authors reason about one set of numbers.
refund_rationale: At full refund the most polarised legal build cost LESS than a moderate one under every candidate curve - negatives refunded more than elite positives cost, which is the unrestricted upward stacking Rule 10 forbids. Halving the refund inverts that ordering: measured net for the sandbox fixtures becomes 100 (broad-modest), 180 (two elite plus mild negatives), 230 (polarised).
cap_scope_definition: The cap applies only to builds declaring EVERY attribute in data/attribute_families.json. Partial sandbox fixtures are balance instruments, not fighters; their cost is reported but not capped, because cost scales with how many attributes are declared and a single absolute cap cannot span both cases.
cap_calibration: Derived from a reference complete build sitting near several Rule 10 caps at once (one +100, a second attribute above +70, two severe negatives, two related negatives below -30). That build nets 869; the cap is set at 1000, roughly 15% headroom.
recalibration_trigger: Recalibrate when the first complete roster characters are authored. The cap is currently justified by ONE modelled build (fixtures/fighters/legal/reference_complete_shape.json), which is evidence but not much of it (Rule 18).
